thread:
incident-bot: P1: model warmup failure storm in eu-central-1. Multiple nodes hitting OOM during load; containers restarting. Paging on-call SRE @Sam and runtime eng @Nisha. :rotating_light:
Sam: acknowledged. seeing repeated container restarts and a surge in 5xx for the region. standing by.
Nisha: putting myself as incident lead. quick summary from runtime logs: mix of GPU OOMs, artifact deserialize failures, and JIT compile timeouts during warmup. sample log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T15:02:11Z] ERROR loader: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY while allocating 4.1G for weights shard 2 of 6
[2026-03-15T15:02:11Z] ERROR deserialize: checksum mismatch for artifact model_v20260315.tar (expected=0x9f3a, actual=0x8b2d)
[2026-03-15T15:02:13Z] ERROR jit: op fused_attention compile timeout after 90s (attempt 1)
[2026-03-15T15:02:20Z] INFO runtime: restarting container (exit_code=137)
```
Theo: I'm pulling affected tenant list now. initial estimate: ~9 tenants with >30% errors; top ones are NovaSearch, Shopkit, and Medlytics. latency spike for everyone using long context >8k.
Carla: oncall for customer comms. crafting message to affected customers now.
Nisha: short mitigations we can flip now: 1) divert traffic for this model to quantized variant (model-q8_0) 2) set WARMUP_CONCURRENCY=1 and WARMUP_RETRIES=2 3) disable eager JIT for warmup (JIT_EAGER=0) 4) fallback routing to smaller instance type / dedicated pool.
Sam: agree. prioritize routing + concurrency limit first to stop stampede.
Theo: support data: NovaSearch accounts for 42% of errors; Shopkit 18%. sending ticket links.
Carla: posted notice to status page: "Investigating model warmup failures in eu-central-1 affecting some customers; mitigation underway. No evidence of data loss." (follow-up emails drafted).
Nisha: applying runtime overrides to canary nodes now:
```bash
redwoodctl set-config runtime/eu-central-1 --env WARMUP_CONCURRENCY=1 WARMUP_RETRIES=2 JIT_EAGER=0 MODEL_PREFERRED_VARIANT=model-q8_0
redwoodctl restart service/runtime --tag warmup-canary
```
ops-bot: on-call handoff: Nisha is incident lead at 1768460060. Sam will remain primary SRE.
Nisha: canary warmups: 6/8 succeeded (was 2/8). failures show remaining due to checksum mismatch. digging artifact store.
Sam: artifact store shows partial upload for model_v20260315? checking uploader logs.
Theo: found 3 artifacts with bad checksums on s3-replica-eu. previous version model_v20260310 is intact. suggestion: fail-fast on checksum mismatch and fallback to last-known-good artifact.
Nisha: patching loader to fail-fast when checksum mismatch and skip to fallback variant. applying to canary:
```bash
redwoodctl deploy runtime/loader --patch '{"fail_on_checksum": true, "fallback_variant": "model-q8_0", "artifact_fallback_version": "v20260310"}'
```
Carla: contacting NovaSearch PM. they've acknowledged contingency plan and will accept temporary perf drop to quantized variant.
Theo: rolling routing rule to divert 60% of NovaSearch traffic to dedicated-small pool while we complete artifact repair:
```bash
redwoodctl route add --from tenant:NovaSearch --to pool:dedicated-eu-small --weight 60 --condition model=prod/llama-70b
```
Nisha: after fallback + concurrency change, region-wide warmup success rate went from 24% -> 91% in 9 minutes. 5xx count dropped ~65%. still seeing longer tail compile timeouts on sequences >= 16384. increasing compile timeout heuristics for large-op JIT to 300s for large-models only.
Sam: I'm capturing incident timeline and will open high-priority postmortem. immediate action items: artifact validation on upload, warmup concurrency default to 1 for big models, automated quantized fallback after N warmup failures. assigning owners.
Rafi: ops (support) update: opened tickets for 9 customers, direct contact for NovaSearch and Shopkit. most accept temporary degraded perf. ETA to full normalization ~1 hour as we shift traffic and repair artifacts.
Carla: status page updated with ETA and customer note. support messages sent.
Theo: artifact repair: re-uploading model shards to s3-replica-eu and verifying checksums now.
Nisha: will leave overrides in place for 1 hour after stabilization then hand off to next rotation. leaving watch on warmup metrics and retry logs.
Sam: good work. please capture logs/configs for postmortem. suggested postmortem items: 1) uploader validation + retry logic 2) loader checksum handling and clear fallback path 3) warmup concurrency and rate-limiting defaults 4) compile-time heuristics per op/seq-len.
Carla: follow-ups assigned: NovaSearch comms (Carla), artifact repair (Theo), loader harden (Nisha), postmortem writeup (Sam). :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (reduced customer impact, monitoring), severity P1 -> P2 at 1768460275.
